description: This file defines a FastAPI application with a route that uses dependency injection to handle common query parameters, and demonstrates the use of dependency classes with Python type annotations.

classes.name: CommonQueryParams
classes.description: A class encapsulating common query parameters (q, skip, limit) for API endpoints.

methods.name: CommonQueryParams.__init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing query parameters with default values and optional q parameter.

methods.name: read_items(commons: Annotated[CommonQueryParams, Depends()])
methods.description: Asynchronous route handler that returns a filtered list of items from the fake database, demonstrating dependency injection using Annotated and Depends.

methods.name: __init__(self, q: str | None = None, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 100)
